Evidence/VIS-E-MONEY-RULE-STACK
Evidence record

What must sit underneath a mobile wallet?

What does this evidence establish?

The mobile e-money instructions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) of 9 August 2023 regulate e-money services of non-bank financial institutions under its supervision and set consumer-protection duties, including handling complaints within 10 business days and keeping a complaint register. The amendment of 9 July 2025 permits e-money in US dollars, Saudi riyals and UAE dirhams alongside Yemeni rials, does not allow conversion from rials into foreign currency within its scope, and sets ceilings for individual accounts: YER 1,000,000 per transaction, 2,000,000 per day, 5,000,000 per month and 50,000,000 per year; USD 400, 500, 1,000 and 10,000 or equivalent for foreign-currency accounts; and maximum balances of YER 8,000,000 and USD 1,500 or equivalent. These are legal limits, not observed balances, use or market size, and the evidence does not identify a complete current set of named providers.

What does it measure?

The permissions, restrictions, consumer-protection duties and transaction and balance ceilings that the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) sets for mobile e-money services in its 2023 instructions and their 2025 amendment.

Who or what does it apply to?

Mobile e-money accounts regulated under the cited instructions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden)

When was it measured or observed?

2023 base rules + 2025 amendment

How current is it?

The latest instrument in this record is the amendment signed on 9 July 2025, which took effect on issuance; the base instructions date from 9 August 2023. A consolidated register of later amendments is not held here, so the rules should not be read as current beyond that date without checking for a newer amendment.

What this evidence does not establish

The ceilings are legal limits, not observed use, balances or market size, and the regulated class is not a current list of named providers.

Method and verification detailAdditional detail for reproducing or challenging the reading without changing the evidence meaning.

How was it produced?

Rules are taken from the text of the mobile e-money instructions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) of 9 August 2023 and the signed amendment of 9 July 2025, and grouped as permissions, consumer-protection duties, restrictions and ceilings. The 2022 rules for payment service providers are also cited.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.
